parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Used to ensure that the resource being modified matches the expected resource. The value is obtained from the responses of [CreateFunction](~~415747~~), [GetFunction](~~415750~~), and [UpdateFunction](~~415749~~).

parameters.name: X-Fc-Account-Id
parameters.description: The ID of your Alibaba Cloud account.

parameters.name: X-Fc-Code-Checksum
parameters.description: The CRC-64 value of the function code package.

parameters.name: X-Fc-Date
parameters.description: The start date of the function invocation in the format of **EEE,d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT**.

parameters.name: X-Fc-Trace-Id
parameters.description: The invocation ID of the function, which corresponds to the requestId in the response.

parameters.name: functionUpdateFields
parameters.description: The request struct for updating a function.
